name: Compress Image to Exact File Size (KB)

seo.title: Compress Image to Exact File Size (KB) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Iteratively compress an image to the closest safe result at or below a requested file-size budget.

assumptions: The target is treated as an upper bound, not a promise of byte-perfect equality.
limitations: Encoder output is discrete; exact byte size may be impossible. Very small targets may require reduced dimensions.
